## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes, and I added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (and `npm run desktop:smoke` if I touched `electron/` or `server/`)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased) if behavior or setup changed
- [ ] New UI text has both English and Turkish strings
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes (both themes if colours changed)
